definitions.explanation: A wall, screen, curtain, or piece of furniture that divides one room or space into smaller ones.

examples.japanese: {間仕切|まじき}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: To put up a room divider.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間仕切|まじき}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use a curtain as a room divider.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間仕切|まじき}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧、{子|こ}ども{部屋|べや}にした。
examples.english: We divided the large room in two with a partition and made children's rooms.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{間|ま}→間：30796_ma⟧ (room, space) + ⟦{仕切|しき}り→仕切り：11431_shikiri⟧ (partition). Common in real-estate listings and home-goods shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間仕切|まじき}り⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: partition wall
- {間仕切|まじき}り⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧: dividing curtain
- {間仕切|まじき}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ / ⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to put in / take out a partition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧: sliding paper door — the traditional partition between rooms of a Japanese house
